text.en: Believing a galaxy cluster's ordinary (baryonic, non-dark-matter) mass budget is dominated by the visible galaxies themselves, since galaxies are what actually get counted and named -- X-ray observations show that the hot intracluster medium, gas heated to tens of millions of kelvin as it fell into the cluster and shock-heated, actually contains several times more ordinary matter than all the cluster's galaxies combined; galaxies are the visually striking component but not the dominant baryonic reservoir.
text.et: Arvamus, et galaktikaparve tavalise (barüonilise, mitte tumeaine) massi eelarves domineerivad nähtavad galaktikad ise, kuna galaktikad on see, mida tegelikult loendatakse ja nimetatakse -- röntgenvaatlused näitavad, et kuum parvedevaheline aine, gaas, mis kuumutati kümnete miljonite kelvinideni, kui see parvesse langes ja löökainelt kuumenes, sisaldab tegelikult mitu korda rohkem tavalist ainet kui kõik parve galaktikad kokku; galaktikad on visuaalselt silmatorkav komponent, kuid mitte domineeriv barüoniline varu.
